note: Consolidation C3 (lane disposition 2026-10-15): F36, the health/audit plane, is the largest WS2 family without a manifest (premarket F11 and after-close F12 already have theirs). The host can serialise only its single-slot weekday-morning checks without changing a cadence; those four lines become stage `morning`. Every other live F36 line is listed under deferred (multi-slot or already a fabric lane) or excluded (STAY_HOST: sender, keep-on-cron, n8n monitors) with its reason. Commands are VERBATIM crontab commands (line numbers: crontab -l 2026-10-15, sha256 6a5c6768); each step keeps its own flock and log. NEVER_SCHEDULED: no crontab line runs the runner until the operator flip packet (docs/ops/packets/consolidation-health-audit-c3-20261015/).
